title: Lester Young's private vocabulary
summary: Young gave nicknames such as Lady Day, Holy Man and Sweets.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Let me ask you about some of the personalities in the band. You talked a little about Lester Young. Did he have his unique way of speaking, his own language?

Yeah, he had his own vocabulary. He had a lot of words, they had different meanings. He called Basie “Holy Man” because at that time Basie used to carry the money. Naturally, he named Billie Holiday, “Lady Day.” Named me “Sweets.” He named Buck “Green Eyes” because Buck had green eyes. There was “La dee dah,” he used to say that all the time, if you got broke and shot your last money and you didn’t have any to bet again, he would say, “La dee dah, that’s all for you, la dee dah.”
You said he had the bell and he could get people to gong…was he looked up to as a leader?
No, he wasn’t looked up to, he was just funny.
